Name: Bonster's Greenhouse
Author: rjgilber
Description: This mod was created to offer options for people who really, really like to plant things. Specifically, I created it because I wanted more spaces for modded crops, especially trees. It consists of three floors of planting room, including one floor for trees, one primarily for field crops and one that matches the vanilla greenhouse. Each large plot is sized for iridium sprinklers, with smaller side plots for trellis crops, and individual spots for trees. The bottom floor has a small "room" for chests, machines or other items. Enjoy your harvest!
